_note: 3D surface (item i). Uses the same LOLA heights as the 2D map (data/map/<site>.json, config/map2d.json): no new data. The page draws the ground seen from above at a fixed tilt; the reader turns it to any compass direction. Heights (and the vertical part of the Sun and Earth lines) are stretched by `exaggeration` so the relief is visible; the page states the factor. Colours and relief shading are the same as the 2D map.
_note_lander: From the lander (ADR 0103): perspective view from the observer of the terrain skyline (data/horizon site_height_m + observer_height_m) over the same heights, on a sphere of moon_radius_km, heights NOT stretched so every angle is true. hfov_deg = horizontal field of view; the canvas is canvas_width_px wide and aspect × that tall; Sun and Earth discs are drawn to scale (radii = config/view.json timeline.year.disc_radius_deg). every_cells = grid step of the ground; near_km = nearest ground drawn. The view opens aim_above_deg above the chosen body so the skyline sits in the lower part. Drag turns the view (drag_deg_per_px × field of view per CSS px), arrow keys by key_step_deg; pitch stays in pitch_min_deg..pitch_max_deg. The 3D ground's own skyline is sampled every gap_az_step_deg / gap_km_step and compared with the LOLA 80 m profile; differences above gap_note_deg are stated in the caption. Compass labels every tick_step_deg.
